== Description ==
Team tournament final score sheets (third of three photographs), 23 October at the [[2026 World Championship]].

== Source and credit ==
Photograph from [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kfKrKW_o-em-1dUsWMBsiWer9SBchwan/view Team Tournament Final Score Sheet 3 10.23.26 World's 2026.jpg], in the shared Worlds 2026 Photos & Videos album ([https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yEnw5u2fcKsynieu6KP4DVFEK-IwGuHL folder]).

== Changes ==
Full frame retained. Encoded orientation normalized, score sheets rotated for reading, and longest edge limited to 2,400 pixels without upscaling; camera metadata removed.
